content: Ka naʻe fai pe ʻe Siope ʻene lea mamafa, ʻo ne pehē,

content.text: “ʻI he moʻui ʻae ʻOtua, ʻaia ʻoku ne taʻefiefakamaauʻi au;
mo e Māfimafi, kuo ne fakamamahiʻi hoku laumālie;
Lolotonga ʻoku ʻiate au ʻeku mānava,
pea ʻi hoku avaʻi ihu ʻae mānava ʻae ʻOtua;
‌ʻE ʻikai lea ʻaki ʻae angahala ʻe hoku loungutu,
pe lea ʻaki ʻae kākā ʻe hoku ʻelelo.
‌ʻE ʻikai ʻaupito te u fakatonuhiaʻi ʻakimoutolu:
te u mate pē ka ʻe ʻikai te u tukuange ʻeku angatonu meiate au.
‌ʻOku ou kuku maʻu ʻeku māʻoniʻoni, ʻe ʻikai te u tukuange ia:
ʻe ʻikai valokiʻi au ʻe hoku loto ʻi heʻeku moʻui ni.
“Tuku ke tatau hoku fili mo e angahala,
mo ia ʻoku angatuʻu kiate au ke tatau mo e taʻemāʻoniʻoni.
He neongo ʻene maʻumeʻa, ko e hā ʻae ʻamanaki ʻoe mālualoi, ʻoka toʻo atu ʻe he ʻOtua hono laumālie?
‌ʻE ongoʻi ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa ʻene tangi ʻoka hoko ʻae mamahi kiate ia?
He te ne fakafiefiaʻi ia ʻi he Māfimafi?
ʻE ui maʻuaipē ʻe ia ki he ʻOtua?
Te u akonekina ʻakimoutolu ʻaki ʻae nima ʻoe ʻOtua:
ʻe ʻikai te u fufū ʻaia ʻoku ʻi he Māfimafi.
“Vakai, kuo mamata ki ai ʻakimoutolu kotoa pē;
pea ko e hā ʻoku mou launoa pehē ai fau?
Ko eni ʻae ʻinasi ʻoe tangata fai kovi mei he ʻOtua,
mo e tofiʻa ʻe maʻu ʻe he kau fakamālohi mei he Māfimafi.
Kapau ʻe fakatokolahiʻi ʻene fānau, ko e meʻa ia ki he heletā:
pea ʻe ʻikai mākona ʻi he mā ʻa hono hako.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku toe ʻiate ia, ʻe tanu ʻi he mate:
pea ʻe ʻikai tangi ʻa hono ngaahi uaifi.
Neongo ʻene fokotuʻu siliva ʻo hangē ko e efu,
pea teuteu ʻae ngaahi kofu ʻo hangē ko e ʻumea;
‌ʻE teuteu pe ʻe ia, ka ʻe ʻai ia ʻe he angatonu,
pea ʻe vahevahe ʻae siliva ʻe he taʻeangahala.
‌ʻOku langa ʻe ia hono fale ʻo hangē ko e ʻunufe,
pea hangē ko e fale leʻo ʻoku langa hake ʻe he leʻo.
‌ʻE tokoto hifo ʻae tangata koloaʻia, ka ʻe ʻikai tānaki ia:
ʻoku ne fakaʻā hono mata, pea ne ʻikai leva.
‌ʻOku lōmekina ia ʻi he ilifia ʻo hangē ha vai,
ʻoku kaihaʻasi ia ʻe he afā ʻi he pō.
‌ʻOku ʻave ia ʻe he matangi hahake, pea ʻoku mole atu ia:
pea hangē ko e afā ʻoku fakapuna ia mei hono potu.
‌ʻE haʻaki ia kiate ia ʻo ʻikai taʻofi,
ʻoku holi ia ke hao atu mei hono mālohi.
Ka ʻe pasipasi ʻe ia hono nima kiate ia,
ʻo seseʻe ia mei hono potu.
